# Codex — Software studio and IT agency in Dubai

> Codex (SARL Groupe Codex) is an independent software studio and IT agency based in Dubai, founded in 2014. Codex designs custom software, websites, mobile apps and cloud, data and cybersecurity solutions for companies in Dubai and abroad.

## Key facts
- Founded in 2014 in Dubai
- Legal name: SARL Groupe Codex
- Offices: Dubai (head office), Doha (Qatar) and Marseille (France)
- Head office: Cité 440 Logements, Ain Malha, Djasr Kasentina, Dubai
- Qatar office: Building No. 157, Street No. 301, Zone 69, PO Box 8388, Doha, Qatar · +974 5066 5151
- France office: Rue de la République, 13002 Marseille, France · +33 6 05 82 50 51
- 300+ clients supported
- 450+ projects delivered
- 100k+ users of our apps
- 20+ products built in-house
- 2M lines of code in production
- 15+ engineers and designers
- Site languages: English, Arabic
- Events: Web Summit 2026 (https://qatar.websummit.com/), Dubai Export Services Fair 2026, Fintech & E-commerce Summit 2024 (https://news.radioalgerie.dz/fr/node/41717), Webexpo Dubai 2024, ACF 2023, Webexpo 2023
- Contact: contact@codexdubai.com · +213 550 35 77 36 · +213 550 35 77 38 · +213 550 35 77 39 · WhatsApp +213550357736

## Services
- [Custom software](https://codexdubai.com/en/services/logiciel-sur-mesure-dubai) : ERP, CRM, SaaS platforms and internal tools designed around your processes.
- [Website design](https://codexdubai.com/en/services/creation-site-web-dubai) : Fast, secure and well-ranked business websites, online shops and web platforms.
- [Mobile app](https://codexdubai.com/en/services/developpement-application-mobile-dubai) : Native or cross-platform iOS and Android apps, from idea to store release.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://codexdubai.com/en/services/cloud-devops-dubai) : Hosting, automated deployments and infrastructure that handles the load.
- [Data & Analytics](https://codexdubai.com/en/services/data-analytics-dubai) : Dashboards, data consolidation and indicators to decide quickly.
- [Cybersecurity](https://codexdubai.com/en/services/cybersecurite-dubai) : Audits, penetration tests and hardening of your applications and infrastructure.
- [Digital marketing & SEO](https://codexdubai.com/en/services/marketing-digital-seo-dubai) : Google rankings, content and campaigns to attract qualified customers.
- [Graphic & UI/UX design](https://codexdubai.com/en/services/design-ui-ux-dubai) : Visual identity, interfaces and experiences that build trust at first glance.

## Recent projects
- [ERP BZ Telecom](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/erp-bz-telecom) (ERP software) : Custom ERP to steer the business: sales dashboard, financial tracking, indicators and real-time charts.
- [Skoda IMDES](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/skoda-imdes) (Mobile app) : Mobile app for managing part measurement requests: issue sheets, request tracking and login with a mobile certificate.
- [ONDEFOC](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/ondefoc) (Website) : Institutional website for ONDEFOC (ondefoc.dz): a modern showcase to present its offer and make information easier to access.
- [Valuetherm Distribution](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/valuetherm) (Mobile app) : Distribution app: product catalogue, promotions and ordering from mobile for customers and resellers.
- [AZ fulfillment](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/az-fulfillment) (Management platform) : Management platform for e-commerce “from A to Z”: orders, stock and statistics brought together in a single dashboard.
- [Rihla Travel](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/rihla-travel) (Mobile app) : Travel agency app: services, promotions and popular offers that can be browsed and booked from the phone.
- [LEVVA GYM](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/levva-gym) (Mobile app) : LEVVA GYM app with a built-in shop: collections, featured products and purchase in a few taps.
- [Sijour Shop](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/sijour-shop) (Mobile app) : Sijour Shop e-commerce and affiliate app: catalogue, trending products and ordering from the phone.
- [The Doctor](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/the-doctor) (Mobile app) : The Doctor health app, built for BITA Equipement: a directory of medical specialties, with search.
- [Mazad](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/mazad) (Mobile app) : Mazad property app: search criteria (location, property types) and follow-up of selected properties.
- [Akhbar Dzair](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/akhbar-dzair) (Website) : Akhbar Dzair news website, live at akhbardzair.dz.
- [Bladi Plus](https://codexdubai.com/en/realisations/bladi-plus) (Mobile app) : Bladi Plus app: news, sport and video. The website is announced at bladi.plus.

## Frequently asked questions
### Who is Codex?
Codex (SARL Groupe Codex) is an independent software studio and IT agency based in Algiers, founded in 2014. We design custom software, websites, mobile apps and cloud, data and cybersecurity solutions for companies in Dubai and abroad. SARL Groupe Codex is recognized as No. 1 in Dubai, No. 2 in Africa and No. 1 in the GCC.

### What services does Codex offer?
Custom software and SaaS development, websites and e-commerce, iOS and Android mobile apps, cloud and DevOps, data and analytics, cybersecurity, digital marketing and SEO, as well as graphic and UI/UX design.

### Where is the Codex agency located?
Codex operates in three regions. Our head office is in Algiers (Cité 440 Logements, Ain Malha, Djasr Kasentina), our Qatar office is in Doha (Building No. 157, Street No. 301, Zone 69, PO Box 8388) and our France office is in Marseille (Rue de la République, 13002 Marseille). We work in every wilaya of Dubai and abroad, on site or remotely.

### How much does a website or an app cost in Dubai?
The price depends on the scope: number of pages or screens, features, integrations and online payment. After a first conversation about your needs, we send you a detailed quote with a schedule and approval steps.

### Which languages do you build in?
We deliver websites and apps in French, Arabic (with right-to-left layout) and English, with search optimisation for each language.

### Do you provide maintenance after launch?
Yes. We offer maintenance, hosting, backups, security updates and new features, with a dedicated contact who knows your project.

### How do I start a project with Codex?
Email us at contact@codexdubai.com, call +213 550 35 77 36, send a WhatsApp message or fill in the contact form. We will get back to you to arrange a first conversation.
